text: 下周外盘看点丨美国CPI如何影响美联储，苹果秋季发布会来了 下周最大焦点锁定在美国通胀数据；外界预计苹果届时将发布首款折叠屏iPhone；甲骨文、梅西百货等将发布财报。
text_en: Next week's overseas market watch: How US CPI affects Fed, Apple autumn launch event arrives; next week's biggest focus is US inflation data; Apple is expected to unveil its first foldable iPhone; Oracle, Macy's and others to report earnings.
